svg.title: Monetta proposed iPhone Duo layouts
svg.desc: Concept board showing a compact product page, a collection beside selected product details on the inner landscape display, and a seated arrangement with the gallery above the fold and purchase controls below. All retain the same product selection.
svg.text: A continuous shopping journey. More room to see, choose, and buy.
A piece, a price, a clear next step.
Readable content inside the safe region.
Text and purchase controls stay full size.
La pieza completa. Todos sus detalles.
Tu selección y tus filtros se conservan.
Keep the collection in view. Let product details grow into the available space.
La misma pieza, a tu manera.
Use measured regions and safe areas.
Keep actions away from the active fold.
Keep the selected product and variant.
Adapt navigation to the system bar axis.
Every action remains available when closed.
CONCEPT ONLY · Layout schematics; system geometry and catalog content are illustrative. Not App Store captures.
